image_description: A close-up shot of a medical professional (likely a nurse or doctor) applying an adhesive bandage to the upper arm of a young boy. The boy is seated, wearing a light t-shirt and tan pants. The adult's hands are visible wrapping the beige bandage around the child's bicep. A large semi-transparent watermark 'FOTOSA' overlays the center of the image.

The skin texture on the adult's hands appears slightly overly smooth and waxy, lacking fine pore detail, which is a common subtle artifact in AI-generated human subjects, though it could also be due to soft-focus photography.
